english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for meat from cattle or other bovines.
Use this specifically when “cow” means beef as food.

examples.english: The beef at this restaurant is very tender.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ngau4 juk6 hou2 nyun6

examples.english: We’re having cow for dinner tonight.
